TASK-001.title: Add decision build and decision compiler orchestration
TASK-001.summary: Introduce vNext decision-build support and decision compiler orchestration behind compatibility so routine intent-to-knowledge work can combine semantic approval, KB preflight, KB updates, and row-to-KB evidence.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki can create and validate decision_build artifacts through compatibility-safe decision orchestration without breaking existing feedback/documentation flows.
acceptance: Decision build kind/schema is represented in domain/application/adapters behind compatibility.
Decision orchestration supports proposal and accepted modes with no canonical writes before approval.
Accepted decision artifacts record approved rows, row-to-KB mappings, product/system propagation direction, assumptions, risks, and downstream planning questions.
Existing feedback_build and documentation_build flows keep working and tests cover compatibility.
non_goals: Do not remove feedback_build or documentation_build support.
Do not migrate all tool-surface consolidation in this task.
Do not implement graph diagram-ref audits or gate fast paths in this task.
verification: Run typecheck and focused build/tool smoke tests.
Validate decision-build traceability with a new or updated smoke test.
Run CodeWiki alignment and stale-reference audits.

delta.desired: Decision compiler and decision_build compatibility support only.
delta.current: No vNext decision_build support exists yet.

TASK-002.title: Implement diagram-backed system KB audits and graph nodes
TASK-002.summary: Parse system diagram YAML into first-class graph refs and audit system docs against diagram_refs and requires_doc rules after migration flags are enabled.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki can treat system diagrams as the system ontology and detect orphan docs, missing diagram refs, stale refs, and requires_doc gaps.
acceptance: Diagram YAML parser exposes components, adapters, flows, domain entities, lifecycles, policies, artifacts, actors, and external systems as graph/audit refs.
System docs can declare diagram_refs in frontmatter and audits verify target existence.
Diagram nodes can declare requires_doc and audits report missing owning docs.
Migration mode can warn before hard enforcement so existing repos can adopt gradually.
non_goals: Do not require every diagram node to have a doc.
Do not replace renderer-specific diagram output in this task.
Do not implement default graph lens simplification in this task.
verification: Add tests for valid refs, missing refs, missing requires_doc docs, and migration warning mode.

delta.current: System diagram YAML exists but docs are not validated against diagram refs.

TASK-003.title: Add validation preflight and risk-tier policy
TASK-003.summary: Add gateway preflight and risk-tier policy so low-risk mechanical/docs cleanup avoids late metadata blocks while high-risk work escalates to user semantic approval.

goal.outcome: Gateways can preflight required metadata/audits/proof before expensive validation and apply risk-tiered user escalation policy.
acceptance: Preflight reports missing upstream builds, audit evidence, task ids, content proof strategy, stale refs, and close/publication blockers before fresh validation handoff.
Risk tiers distinguish mechanical/docs cleanup, code-local, semantic-system, security/migration/publication, and destructive changes.
Low-risk fast path remains gateway-validated and records why user approval is not required beyond accepted semantics.
High-risk categories escalate to user approval before lower-layer promotion.
non_goals: Do not weaken implementation/task-close/publication content-proof requirements.
Do not bypass fresh validation where policy requires independence.
Do not consolidate public tool surface in this task.
verification: Add gateway/preflight tests for missing metadata, fast path eligibility, and escalation categories.
Run validation smoke tests and CodeWiki audits.

TASK-004.title: Simplify generated state graph lenses
TASK-004.summary: Refactor generated state output to expose a compact Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, Proof default lens while preserving exact trace/audit expansion for gateways.

goal.outcome: Default CodeWiki state and graph views are simpler and lower-token while trace/audit lenses still expose full evidence refs.
acceptance: Default state/view groups hot context into Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof families.
Build and validation internals collapse to badges in default views when not the next action.
Trace/audit lenses expand exact source refs, requirements, validation reports, and content proof for gateways.
State/graph output remains generated and does not become canonical truth.
non_goals: Do not drop any evidence needed by validation, archive, restore, or publication.
Do not implement diagram_ref auditing in this task.
verification: Add graph/state tests for default lens and trace/audit expansion.

TASK-005.title: Consolidate CodeWiki public and agent tool surface
TASK-005.summary: Introduce a smaller vNext public and agent workflow tool surface while keeping low-level primitives available internally or through compatibility aliases during migration; after the role worktree/publisher path lands, remove or extract the /wiki-session-handoff compatibility shim instead of preserving it as user-facing surface.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki exposes fewer, more powerful workflow tools/commands for common use while existing primitive tools remain compatible until deprecation is validated; once role worktree/publisher orchestration is validated, the /wiki-session-handoff compatibility shim is removed or extracted from user-facing workflow surface.
acceptance: Public command surface is documented around status, decide, work, audit, and maintain concepts.
Agent-facing workflow tools or orchestrators cover state, decision, work, gate, maintenance, and coordination phases.
Low-level primitives remain callable through compatibility/debug paths and are not removed prematurely.
Tool catalog, Pi adapter exposure, README, and skills consistently describe public/agent/internal surfaces.

After TASK-006 validates isolated worktree/publisher orchestration, /wiki-session-handoff is removed or extracted from normal user-facing recovery flow with migration tests proving intended compatibility/debug behavior.
non_goals: Do not create a single opaque do-everything tool.
Do not remove existing public primitives until migration and deprecation tests pass.
Do not remove or extract /wiki-session-handoff before TASK-006 validates isolated worktree/publisher orchestration.
Do not implement decision_build schema in this task.
verification: Run tool catalog and adapter smoke tests.
Verify old tool names still work during compatibility.
Run session-handoff smoke tests proving the remaining command/debug path, or its removal, matches documented public surface after TASK-006 lands.

delta.desired: Public/agent tool surface is consolidated and /wiki-session-handoff compatibility shim is removed or extracted after the isolated worktree/publisher path is safe.
delta.current: Low-level primitives and /wiki-session-handoff compatibility executor remain visible during migration; cleanup is unsafe while sessions share dirty root worktrees.

SPRINT-001.title: CodeWiki vNext decision and graph workflow
SPRINT-001.outcome: Deliver the vNext operating model in bounded compatibility-safe increments: decision builds, diagram-backed system docs, simpler graph lenses, risk-tier gates, and consolidated workflow tools.
gates: Keep current CodeWiki public behavior frozen except critical blocker fixes until vNext replacement flows validate.
Do not remove compatibility feedback/documentation/build/tool primitives before deprecation tests pass.
Each task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.
